OVER 30 YEARS OF SUCCESS​
​With small class sizes and experienced,
enthusiastic and inspiring teachers, the nurturing and supportive environment at Wentworth College allows every
student to thrive and succeed.
We're a small, progressive GCSE and A-level college based in London, NW11. You can get in touch by calling us on
020 8458 8524 or by using our Contact page below.
"Every young person is unique... and so are we."
Manuel Guimaraes, Principal

"Wentworth is well known for its small classes and individual attention... and a strong reputation for academic rigour and excellence."
Manuel Guimaraes, Principal
Wentworth College is a small and progressive GCSE and A-level college based in London, NW11.
The college was founded in 1989 by Alan Davies, a successful teacher and senior A-level examiner, to provide high-quality A-level and GCSE tuition to students in North-West London.
Over time the college developed to offer full courses for students in years 10-13; however, we still retain our core approach of small classes, flexible courses, and experienced, enthusiastic teachers.
Although Alan Davies retired as principal in 2017, he is still a key member of staff, and most of our teachers have more than ten years experience with us. Our current principal, Manuel Guimaraes, has been with the college for more than 15 years.
We hope you'll take the time to learn about the range of courses on offer, and how Wentworth has been getting the best out of our students for almost 30 years.
You can find out more about the college's unique learning environment by viewing our prospectus using the button below.
